name: Pi Agent in Practice: Setup, Custom Extensions & 5 Best Practices - HoangYell
description: Install the CLI globally via npm (npm i -g --ignore-scripts @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent), authenticate via /login or point to local inference via ~/.pi/agent/models.json, and harness its 7 core primitives (read, write, edit, bash, grep, find, ls).
